capabilities.label: Submit a generation
capabilities.description: Run a text-to-image or text-to-video generation in Vision's open project. Goes through the same queue the PromptBox uses, so the result lands as a real gallery card with its history entry and sidecar.

capabilities.label: Make and edit a GIF
capabilities.description: Build an animated GIF from still cards or a clip of a video card, retime, trim, loop, crop or resize one, cut its subject out onto transparency, or turn it back into a video. Lands as a real gallery card, or as a new entry on the card it came from.
